test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.**

Introductory section of a literary work
solution: The correct answer is '**Prologue**'. ***__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Prologue'. • Prologue: a piece of writing or a speech that introduces a play, poem, etc. (नाटक, कविता आदि को प्रस्‍तुत करने वाला लेख या भाषण; प्रस्‍तावना) • *Example: The **prologue** to the novel is written in the form of a newspaper account.* • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4. Correct Answer:__ Prologue* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words given in the options: **Words** **Meaning** **Dialogue** conversation between people in a book, play, etc. (नाटक आदि में संवाद, लोगों के बीच वार्तालाप) **Epilogue** a short piece that is added at the end of a book, play, etc., and that comments on what has gone before. (किसी पुस्‍तक, नाटक आदि का अंतवचन, उपसंहार, भरत वाक्‍य) **Monologue** a long speech by one person, for example in a play. (अकेले व्यक्ति का लंबा भाषण (जैसे नाटक में), एकालाप; स्‍वगत भाषण) c6:T81b, The correct answer is **'to this rule'.**
